rules.title: Security deposit limit of one month's rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may not demand or receive security, however denominated, greater than one month's rent, in addition to the first month's rent paid on or before initial occupancy. An advance payment of not less than six months' rent is allowed if the lease term is six months or longer.

rules.coverage_text: Security for a rental agreement for residential property used as the tenant's dwelling. It does not cover small landlords meeting the paragraph (5) requirements, who are subject to a two-month limit unless the prospective tenant is a service member.

rules.title: Small landlord security deposit limit of two months' rent
rules.requirement: A landlord who is a natural person, or an LLC whose members are all natural persons, and who owns no more than two residential rental properties with no more than four dwelling units offered for rent, may not demand or receive security greater than two months' rent, in addition to the first month's rent. This does not apply if the prospective tenant is a service member.

rules.title: Higher security for service members: written statement and return
rules.requirement: If a landlord charges a service member a higher than standard or advertised security because of credit history, credit score, housing history or another tenant factor, the landlord must give a written statement of the amount and the reason on or before the lease signing date. The additional amount must be returned after no more than six months of residency if the tenant is not in arrears.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords or their agents renting residential property to a service member who will reside there.
rules.quoted_span: (4) On or after April 1, 2025, if a landlord or its agent charges a service member who rents residential property in which the service member will reside a higher than standard or advertised security pursuant to paragraph (1) due to the credit history, credit score, housing history, or other factor related to the tenant, the landlord shall provide the tenant with a written statement, on or before the date the lease is signed, of the amount of the higher security and an explanation why the higher security amount is being charged.

rules.title: Return of security and itemized statement within 21 days
rules.requirement: No later than 21 calendar days after the tenant has vacated, the landlord must give the tenant an itemized statement of the security received and its disposition, and must return any remaining portion of the security.

rules.penalty: The landlord shall not be entitled to claim any amount of the security if the landlord, in bad faith, fails to comply with this subdivision.
